submission.justification: Algorithm-L3 with a 40 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 91.059% among all candidates across the allowed threshold range. This represents a 5.17% improvement over Algorithm-L2 and a 16.33% improvement over Algorithm-L1. All three algorithms meet the hard latency constraint of 4.0 μs and fit within FPGA resources, but Algorithm-L3 maximizes signal efficiency as required by the task goal. The threshold of 40 GeV falls within the required range of 20-60 GeV and represents the optimal operating point for this algorithm where signal efficiency is maximized while maintaining the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz.
